from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,zipfile
root=Path.cwd(); path=root/'submissions/인지동_ADE-95_독립뷰어_최종제출_20261008.zip'; digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert path.with_suffix('.zip.sha256').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split()[0]==digest
required=['docs/ADE-95-독립뷰어-사용검증.md','logs/ade95_user_execution_evidence.json','logs/1791461196407809300_ade95_user_save1_verify.json','logs/1791461196747017600_ade95_user_save2_verify.json','logs/1791461213565276800_ade95_user_third_frame_verify.json','logs/1791461344831362500_ade95_submission_prepackage.json','src/viewer.py','src/viewer_data.py','src/viewer_render.py','scripts/verify_viewer_outputs.py','scripts/package_ade95.py','requirements-viewer.txt','requirements-viewer.lock.txt','SHA256SUMS.txt','ADE95_SHA256SUMS.txt','ADE95_PACKAGE_INFO.json','logs/ade95_numpy_repair.json','outputs/ade95_final_gui_cli/gui_check.json','logs/1791459841998924200_ade95_final_tests.json']
for folder in ['frame_000003_1791460557654228600','frame_000003_1791460742554215400']:
    required.extend(f'outputs/ade95_final_user_saves/{folder}/{name}' for name in ['points.npz','preview.png','processing.json','viewer_export.json'])
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    names=set(archive.namelist()); prefix='injidong_ade95/'
    assert len(names)==len(archive.namelist())
    for name in required: assert prefix+name in names,name
    assert all('.venv' not in n.split('/') and '__pycache__' not in n.split('/') and not n.endswith(('.pyc','.tmp','.zip')) for n in names)
    lines=archive.read(prefix+'ADE95_SHA256SUMS.txt').decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    entries={}
    for line in lines:
        expected,name=line.split('  ',1); entries[name]=expected
        assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(prefix+name)).hexdigest()==expected,name
    assert {prefix+n for n in entries}==names-{prefix+'ADE95_SHA256SUMS.txt'}
    for name in required:
        if name not in ['ADE95_SHA256SUMS.txt','ADE95_PACKAGE_INFO.json']:
            assert archive.read(prefix+name)==(root/name).read_bytes(),name
    evidence=json.loads(archive.read(prefix+'logs/ade95_user_execution_evidence.json'))
    for folder in evidence['saved_folders']:
        for name,expected in folder['files_sha256'].items():
            assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(prefix+folder['package_copy']+'/'+name)).hexdigest()==expected
            assert hashlib.sha256((root/folder['original']/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
old=root/'submissions/인지동_ADE-95_독립뷰어_20261008.zip'
assert hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='2c95cda0ffb753e869486d7d9fbc2372deda2f2d68667f35bbdcfa2cab0d947f'
print(json.dumps({'status':'success','new_zip':str(path),'sha256':digest,'zip_file_count':len(names),'content_hashes_checked':len(entries),'required_files_checked':len(required),'user_saved_result_files_included':8,'original_sha256sums_unchanged':True,'old_zip_preserved':True,'excluded_venv_cache_pyc_temporary_priorzip':True,'crc_verified':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
